text:
No ethnic group is known for loving dance more than others, since dance exists in every culture and the idea that one group is especially rhythmic is a stereotype. If you mean groups where dance is central to cultural identity, Yoruba communities in West Africa and Irish step dancing are well-documented examples, and flamenco is closely tied to Andalusian Romani (Gitano) communities. These are dance-centered traditions, not evidence that their members dance more than anyone else.
